basics.name: Priyanka Chatterjee
basics.label: Software Engineer · Distributed Systems & Microservices · REST APIs · AWS/GCP · 9,300★ OSS Contributor · 3.5+ Years

summaries.swe-p2: Software Engineer P2 with 3.5+ years of experience and expertise in distributed systems, microservices, REST APIs, and cloud-native development on AWS and GCP. Designed a Go-based REST API microservice as part of a greenfield build of Turbot Guardrails, a cloud-native SaaS platform, and engineered distributed event-driven pipelines at Turbot HQ, cutting resource-discovery latency 70-90%.

work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Designed and developed an internal REST API microservice in Go using the Gin framework as part of a greenfield build of Turbot Guardrails, a cloud-native SaaS platform; secured endpoints with OAuth 2.0 authentication via Auth0, containerized with Docker, deployed to AWS EC2, and served as a gRPC client for several internal microservices.

Built a Kafka-based, event-driven distributed pipeline where consumers asynchronously processed policy-enforcement events in real time; added a dead-letter queue (DLQ) for reliable failure handling and reprocessing.

Optimized complex PostgreSQL queries powering customer compliance audits — rewriting AWS IAM policy-evaluation queries with jsonb array elements and multi-stage CTEs — improving query performance 40% and eliminating a class of false-positive findings.

Engineered core features for Tailpipe, a CLI on DuckDB + Parquet, lifting log-processing throughput 30% to 1,000+ logs per second by chunking and batching file reads and streaming writes; reduced memory use to eliminate out-of-memory failures at scale.
Resolved a production incident by diagnosing a Go service stuck in a Kubernetes CrashLoopBackOff — investigating pod logs and status and collaborating with the platform team to restore service.
Added multi-distro Linux smoke tests to the GitHub Actions CI/CD release pipeline for four open-source Go CLIs, hardening release safety and catching regressions before deployment.
